## About
AA Chicago Transmission is a transmission shop on W Diversey Ave, right at the intersection with Kenneth Ave. We work on automatic and manual transmissions, clutches, transfer cases and the parts that tie them together.
If something feels off, come by and ask Saul Borjas, our shop manager, for a quick diagnostic. We'll road test your vehicle to find out whether the trouble is transmission related before we talk about repairs.
We're a member of ATRA and accredited by the Better Business Bureau, and we take cash or credit cards. Customers have rated us 4.7 across 50 Google reviews.

## Services
- Diagnostic services: External inspection, fluid check, computer diagnostic and road test to find out what's really going on.
- Automatic transmission services: Overhaul or reseal, sensor or solenoid replacement, and fluid and filter replacement.
- Manual transmissions: Rebuild service, clutch replacement, flywheel reconditioning, and master or slave cylinder replacement.
- Transfer cases resealed or rebuilt: We reseal or rebuild transfer cases.
- Transmission related services: Installation or replacement of the transmission computer, wiring, cooler lines, cooler, mounts, shifter cable and flywheel.

## FAQ
Q: How do I know if it's really the transmission?
A: Visit the shop and we'll road test your vehicle to see whether the problem you're having is transmission related.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We take cash or credit cards.
